decisions.reason: Finned tubes are a core component of the firm's air cooler business. They were shown on their own page through 2019, and their manufacturing know-how supports the established offer, so performance is likely near aspiration and there is no strong trigger for problemistic search to reallocate the resources.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes build directly on the firm's tube and exchanger expertise and serve its efficiency and sustainability goals. Although several sibling launches were cut in 2019, this product stayed visible, and with its low incremental cost the firm can keep carrying it from available slack.
